title: Stream now / Digital original
slide_intent: Differentiate immediate action from content classification, because a viewer needs to know both what to do and what is being offered.
strategic_value: The bold italic action word and outlined hatching icon can make Channel 4’s digital-original label recognizable without a separate sub-brand.
demonstration: Two black lines read Stream now and Digital original with a hatching-egg icon, over a pink and red recessed gradient beside a blue strip.
practical_value: Compare an action line with a content-type line when the composition has only a few words.

content_islands.name: Action and classification
content_islands.spec: Stack the two lines at the upper left, emphasize Stream and attach the egg icon to Digital original.

content_islands.name: Color setting
content_islands.spec: Keep the pink/red room-like field dominant with a narrow blue world at left.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study says the graphic system combines clear hierarchy with playful icons integrated into the brand typefaces.
reference_purposes.Expression: Two black lines read Stream now and Digital original with a hatching-egg icon, over a pink and red recessed gradient beside a blue strip.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimen separates the viewing action from the Digital original classification and adds an inline hatching-egg icon.
